title: GC-201 Batch GC201-2024-0847 – Unresolved Discrepancy in CIP Completion Time and Microbial Swab Results

grill_input.description_what_happened: Post-lyophilization CIP cycle on LYOPH-03 was initiated on 2024-02-13 at 13:45. Environmental monitoring swabs were collected from the chamber interior on 2024-02-14 at 08:00. Microbial results returned on 2024-02-14 at 16:30 showing 2 CFU/plate (Bacillus sp.) on one swab location. Batch GC201-2024-0847 had been loaded into the chamber immediately following CIP completion.
grill_input.description_what_should_have_happened: CIP cycle must complete with documented validation. Post-CIP environmental swabs must show ≤1 CFU/plate. Batch loading must not occur until swab results are reviewed and approved.
grill_input.document_deviated_from: SOP-CDMO1-LYOPH-02 (Lyophilizer CIP and Environmental Monitoring), Batch Record GC201-2024-0847, Change Control CC-2024-0312 (LYOPH-03 CIP System Upgrade)
grill_input.immediate_corrections: Batch GC201-2024-0847 was quarantined on 2024-02-14 at 17:15. LYOPH-03 was taken offline. CIP cycle was repeated on 2024-02-15 with post-CIP swabs showing <1 CFU/plate. Batch was released after re-lyophilization of affected vials.

statements.speaker: QA Manager, Siobhan O'Brien
statements.quote: The CIP cycle completed successfully at 14:00 on 2024-02-13. I reviewed the cycle log myself. The equipment was ready for batch loading by 14:30. The swab result of 2 CFU was anomalous—likely a sampling or lab error, not a true equipment state.

statements.speaker: Equipment Operator, Marcus Chen
statements.quote: The CIP cycle ran into a pressure alarm at 14:15. I had to reset the system and restart the rinse phase. The cycle didn't finish until 15:45. I documented it in the equipment log, but I didn't notify QA because the second run looked normal. The swab result makes sense—the equipment wasn't actually clean when the batch went in.

investigation_steps: Reviewed batch record and CIP cycle logs (2024-02-14)
Quarantined batch and initiated repeat CIP (2024-02-14 17:15)
grill_input.root_cause_description: The elevated microbial swab result (2 CFU) is attributed to a potential sampling artifact or laboratory contamination during the swab collection or plating process. The CIP cycle completed nominally at 14:00 per equipment logs reviewed by QA. No evidence of equipment malfunction was identified. The repeat CIP on 2024-02-15 yielded clean results, confirming equipment functionality.
grill_input.impact_assessment: One batch (GC201-2024-0847, ~50,000 units) was exposed to a potentially non-compliant post-CIP environment for approximately 16 hours before quarantine. Microbial swab showed 2 CFU (Bacillus sp.), which exceeds the ≤1 CFU acceptance criterion. However, the root cause is attributed to sampling error, not equipment state. Risk to product quality is considered low given the single elevated swab and successful repeat CIP results.
grill_input.batch_disposition: Quarantined 2024-02-14, re-lyophilized 2024-02-15, released 2024-02-16 pending stability data review.

capa.description: Implement enhanced training for environmental monitoring personnel on aseptic swab collection technique to reduce sampling artifacts. Conduct refresher training for all QA and microbiology staff by 2024-03-31.

grill_input.linked_change_control: CC-2024-0312 (LYOPH-03 CIP System Upgrade, approved 2024-01-15, implemented 2024-02-10)

case_packet.equipment_log_detail: LYOPH-03 CIP cycle initiated 2024-02-13 13:45. Pressure alarm triggered at 14:15 during rinse phase (setpoint 2.8 bar, actual 3.2 bar). System auto-shutdown at 14:17. Manual reset by Operator Chen at 14:18. Rinse phase restarted at 14:20. Cycle completed at 15:47 with all parameters nominal. Log entries timestamped and signed by Chen.
case_packet.operator_training_record: Marcus Chen completed CIP system training on 2024-02-08 (post-upgrade). Training included alarm response procedures. Chen was instructed to notify QA of any cycle interruptions. No notification was made on 2024-02-13.
case_packet.qa_manager_log: Siobhan O'Brien reviewed LYOPH-03 CIP logs on 2024-02-14 at 09:45. She reviewed only the summary screen, which showed 'Cycle Complete – 14:00' (the nominal completion time from the pre-alarm portion). She did not scroll to the detailed event log showing the 14:15 alarm, reset, and 15:47 actual completion.
case_packet.microbial_lab_documentation: Swab collected 2024-02-14 08:00 from chamber interior (location C3, upper shelf). Plating performed by Lab Tech Rajesh Patel using standard aseptic technique. Result: 2 CFU Bacillus sp. on TSA plate. No contamination flags in lab notebook. Positive control (sterile swab) showed 0 CFU. Media sterility check passed. Lab procedure SOP-CDMO1-MICRO-05 followed correctly.
case_packet.repeat_cip_and_swab: CIP cycle on 2024-02-15 13:00–14:45 completed without alarms. Post-CIP swabs collected 2024-02-15 15:00 from same locations as 2024-02-14. All results <1 CFU. Batch re-lyophilized 2024-02-15 16:00–22:00.
case_packet.change_control_cc_2024_0312_detail: LYOPH-03 CIP system upgraded to new pressure control module (Vendor: PharmaClean Systems, Model PCM-4000). Upgrade completed 2024-02-10. FAT/SAT performed 2024-02-10 with no alarms observed. However, SAT protocol did not include a deliberate pressure transient test. Post-upgrade, two other sites (SITE-GC-01, CDMO-2) reported similar pressure alarms on identical systems within 2 weeks of upgrade.
case_packet.true_sequence: The CIP cycle was interrupted by a pressure alarm at 14:15 (likely a calibration drift in the new pressure module). Operator Chen restarted the cycle, which completed at 15:47. The batch was loaded at ~16:15 on 2024-02-13. The swab collected the next morning (08:00 on 2024-02-14) detected 2 CFU—a genuine microbial presence, not a sampling artifact. The equipment was not fully clean when the batch was loaded. The repeat CIP on 2024-02-15 (without the pressure alarm) yielded clean results. QA Manager O'Brien did not see the alarm event because she reviewed only the summary screen and did not cross-check the detailed equipment log against the batch record timeline.
case_packet.pressure_module_investigation_pending: Vendor PharmaClean Systems has been contacted by the Quality team at SITE-GC-01 regarding similar alarms. A root cause analysis of the pressure module is underway but was not included in this deviation investigation.
